The Program Leads for Fusion and Defense continue to own their programs end to end and report to the Executives; the PMO's job is to make sure they, and every future program, are supported by a common, high-quality practice rather than each reinventing one. You build trust quickly and create alignment across program leaders, functional leaders, and the Executive, even when their priorities and operating rhythms differ. We are seeking engineers who bring strong technical depth, hands‑on problem-solving skills, and a passion for building high‑performance hardware that will redefine the future of energy.

You will be an integral part of our team working on design and optimization of unprecedented, multi-megajoule-scale, inertial fusion targets. We are looking for our scientists to apply their technical expertise, problem solving skills, dedication, passion, and vision to positively impact the future of energy!

You will partner closely with leadership to support talent planning, organizational effectiveness, performance management, employee relations, and change management as we continue to rapidly scale. This role requires a well-rounded HR professional who combines strong HR fundamentals with business acumen, sound judgment, and the ability to influence and coach leaders at all levels. You will help managers navigate complex people challenges, identify opportunities to improve team effectiveness, and implement programs and initiatives that support employee development, engagement, and organizational growth. jobs.title: Senior Laser Engineer
jobs.description_text: Xcimer is looking for a Senior Laser Engineer to help us design, build, and productize the high-energy laser systems at the heart of laser-driven inertial fusion. You will bring deep experience with diode-pumped solid-state (DPSS) or gas laser systems and apply it to a first-of-a-kind excimer-based architecture. You will own laser subsystems from concept through hardware, working side by side with laser scientists, optical, mechanical, electrical, controls, and software engineers. Just as importantly, you will help turn research-grade laser hardware into designs that are reliable, repeatable, scalable, and manufacturable. We are looking for our engineers to apply their technical expertise, problem-solving skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact the future of energy!

jobs.title: Senior Laser Engineer - Gas Laser Systems
jobs.description_text: Xcimer is looking for a Senior Laser Engineer to turn modeled gas amplifier behavior into robust, maintainable, high-energy hardware for laser-driven inertial fusion. You will bring deep experience with gas laser systems and apply it to a first-of-a-kind excimer-based architecture. Working with Laser Architecture and Laser Science, you will take modeled amplifier performance, and modify the models where hardware realities require it, and translate it into engineering flow-downs for thermal management, gas flow dynamics, resonator design, contamination control, and more. You will work closely with Mechanical, Opto-Mechanical, and Operations/Manufacturing teams to make sure environmental, structural, and safety requirements are modeled, implemented, and verified in a design that is easy to maintain and operate. We are looking for our engineers to apply their technical expertise, problem-solving skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact the future of energy!

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description_text: As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will be a thought leader in Xcimer influencing and educating technical leads to capture, organize, and track the integrated technical baseline for our IFE Program. The successful candidate will perform leading and supporting roles in establishing and maintaining bidirectional traceability across our requirements, architecture, documentation, and analysis products. The candidate will define and maintain infrastructure, define relationships between internal and external interfaces, and communicate system-level use cases and relationships to a diverse group of stakeholders. The candidate will work with team leads across the organization to craft the key framework and documents needed to define, design, build, test, and activate our facilities and systems. We are looking for engineers to apply their technical expertise, problem solving skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact the future of energy!

jobs.title: Senior Technical Recruiter - Science & Research
jobs.description_text: As a Senior Technical Recruiter – Science & Research, you will own full-lifecycle recruiting for Xcimer's Science organization, helping build a world-class team of physicists, scientists, and researchers advancing the future of fusion energy. This role will focus primarily on recruiting PhD-level scientists and highly specialized technical talent across disciplines such as plasma physics, computational physics, theoretical physics, laser physics, fusion science, and other advanced research fields. You will partner closely with scientific leadership to understand complex technical requirements, develop creative sourcing strategies, and identify exceptional talent across national laboratories, research universities, and advanced technology organizations. We are looking for a highly resourceful, intellectually curious recruiter who enjoys solving difficult talent challenges, thrives in niche technical markets, and can build meaningful relationships with some of the world's leading scientific minds. The ideal candidate combines strong sourcing and research capabilities with a consultative approach to recruiting and a passion for helping build teams tackling ambitious scientific challenges.

jobs.title: Senior/Principial Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description_text: Xcimer Energy leverages decades of research on Inertial Fusion Energy (IFE) combined with groundbreaking new laser architecture. Our mission is to deploy fusion power plants to meet global decarbonization goals as fast as possible. Xcimer has assembled a team of leaders in tough tech, fusion science, and manufacturing with a track record of rapid execution. Supported by leading investors, Xcimer is uniquely positioned to deliver limitless, clean, fusion power to combat climate change. Join us in powering a better world with inertial fusion! This is a full-time, onsite role based at our headquarters in Denver, CO. As a Sr. Mechanical Engineer, you will apply your skills to help define the architecture and scope of extremely large laser systems. We are looking for our engineers to apply their technical expertise, problem solving skills, and dedication to quality to positively impact the future of energy! Candidates may be considered for other positions at Xcimer Energy, and our actual base salary will be determined on an individual basis and may vary based on job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Research Platform
jobs.description_text: We are seeking a founding Staff Software Engineer to build Xcimer's research platform from the ground up. Xcimer is building the world's largest excimer laser to make fusion a practical commercial energy source. Every shot and simulation produces data that our physicists, laser engineers, and controls engineers need to find, trust, and act on quickly. This role builds the software that turns that work into a fast, reliable research loop, shortening the path from a new idea to a trusted simulation result, shot dataset, or dashboard from weeks to hours. You will define the platform architecture, build the first versions yourself, and help hire the team that grows it. Your users are researchers, not software engineers, so success is measured by research throughput. In the first year, the focus is shot data and self-service simulation. The platform's scope expands as the team does. In this role, you will set the foundation for how Xcimer's researchers work with data and computation. The systems you build will shorten iteration cycles across physics, laser, and controls teams, and the standards you establish will shape the software engineering organization as it grows, directly accelerating Xcimer's progress toward commercially viable fusion.

Your ability to manage schedules, maintain project documentation, design- and experiment-review artifacts and facilitate communication across the Implosion System's and sub-systems will be key to driving efficiency and meeting critical design-review and experimental-campaign milestones. We are looking for a highly organized individual with strong problem-solving skills, technical fluency in target physics, ICF implosion, or high-energy-density hardware systems, and experience in all aspects of engineering and research project delivery. The ideal candidate would have demonstrated experience leading engineering or experimental project execution from cradle to grave in the disciplines of inertial confinement fusion, target design, target fabrication, and/or high-energy-density physics.

A high level of integrity, discretion in handling confidential information, and professionalism in dealing with senior leaders within the company are also vital aspects of this role. Most importantly, you must have a genuine passion for the Zoox mission.

jobs.description_text: Zoox is building advanced self-driving hardware and software solutions. To attain the utmost efficiency that the system demands, we need you - an expert who understands both compute hardware architecture as well as the algorithms and middleware that run on it. Your contributions will be instrumental in finding & detecting performance-related trends and anomalies across the robot fleet. The Software Performance team’s mission is to analyze, optimize and provide guidance to the software and hardware teams in order to meet expected system performance & stability targets. As an automation engineer within the Software Performance team, you will build automated instrumentation, benchmarking and analysis for compute performance (CPU, GPU, latency and memory) into the software development and release process. Your work will catch performance regressions before software reaches the fleet, identify trends and anomalies across releases and hardware platforms, and put detailed performance data at the fingertips of performance experts for quick and efficient investigations.

jobs.title: Calibration, Localization and Mapping System Safety Engineer
jobs.description_text: Zoox is on an ambitious journey to develop a full-stack autonomous mobility solution for cities and deploy such a robotaxi solution safely and reliably. The System Design and Mission Assurance (SDMA) team plays a foundational role in the company's success, responsible for constructing the safety case and fail-operational design for our autonomous driving robots before public road deployment. We are seeking a System Safety Engineer to perform safety analyses of complex hardware and software systems, specifically calibration, localization and mapping Systems. You will work across hardware and software domains to develop comprehensive system safety requirements and metrics that ensure safe, fail operational and reliable calibration, localization and mapping capabilities for our autonomous vehicle platform. This work is critical for scaling autonomous driving in a safe and reliable way. We are looking for engineers who are ambitious and excited about helping Zoox deliver on its goals to deliver autonomous mobility. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position.Zoox also offers a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off (e.g. sick leave, vacation, bereavement), unpaid time off, Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights, Amazon RSUs, health insurance, long-term care insurance, long-term and short-term disability insurance, and life insurance.

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Fleet Orchestration Algorithms
jobs.description_text: The Core Data Science team builds the products and data assets that let teams across Zoox measure and improve the autonomy and operational performance of our fleet. In this role, you'll focus on fleet simulation — the environment our data teams use to develop, test, and evaluate the algorithms that orchestrate our autonomous fleet (dispatch, routing, and vehicle assignment) and to understand how those algorithms perform before they reach the road. You’ll piece together the constituent components into a coherent, easy-to-use simulation environment, filling in the gaps, and building generalizable mechanisms so data scientists can measure their algorithm's impact on fleet efficiency. You'll join a diverse, experienced team with rapidly growing scope while working with one of the industry's most valuable autonomous vehicle datasets.

jobs.title: Director, Advanced Hardware Manufacturing
jobs.description_text: Every Zoox vehicle depends on the electronic and sensor hardware our Advanced Hardware Manufacturing team builds and tests. As Director, you will lead the organization that takes this hardware from early builds to serial volume, helping bring safer, cleaner mobility to cities. Our team values safety first, ownership, and learning together. We solve problems in the open and improve how we work every day. You will be part of the Manufacturing Operations leadership team, reporting to the Vice President of Manufacturing Operations. You will partner closely with Hardware Engineering, Test Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Logistics, Environmental Health and Safety (EHS), and Program Management. This role offers room to grow as our production footprint and team expand.

jobs.title: Feature Integration Intern [Summer 2027]
jobs.description_text: About Our Internship Program Zoox's internship program offers hands-on experience with cutting-edge technology, mentorship from some of the industry's brightest minds, and the opportunity to make meaningful contributions to real projects. About the Team The End-to-End (E2E) Feature and Homologation team brings systems engineering focus and discipline to Zoox mobility-as-a-service deployment and operations. The team works with key business stakeholders to define and deliver remarkable product capabilities that span across Vehicle, Autonomy, and Operations segments. We partner with the systems teams from each domain by leveraging their deep technical knowledge, implementation expertise, and validation techniques to deliver a fully verified product capability. About the Role E2E Feature Engineers are the champions of their feature domains which cut across Vehicle, Autonomy, and Operations segments of the Zoox mobility service. You will be responsible for developing Fail-Operational capabilities of the Zoox mobility service. Through strong relationships with internal stakeholders (Product, Safety, Operations, Legal, etc.) and other systems engineers you will deliver: design solutions, systems engineering documentation, multi-quarter capability plans, verification plans, and debug support.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst, Marketing and Commercial
jobs.description_text: The FP&A team at Zoox drives financial analysis of key strategic investments, maintains short and long term financial models, and develops reporting for both internal and external stakeholders. As a Financial Analyst supporting Marketing and Commercial, you will partner with key stakeholders across Marketing, Commercial Market Management, Product, Data Science, and Accounting. Together you will manage planning, forecasting, and performance reporting for Zoox’s marketing and customer promotions investments. You will own the financial models that connect campaigns, discounts, and rider incentives to rider growth, gross bookings, and profitability as Zoox launches its Robotaxi service in new markets. This will require a deep understanding of Zoox’s rider funnel and ridehail economics. It will also require strong working relationships with leaders and individual contributors across multiple departments, and the use of enterprise systems and tools to build robust financial models and dashboards. The goal for this role is to ensure every marketing and promotional dollar is invested with discipline, through timely and actionable financial insights.

jobs.title: Hardware Engineer - Test Development
jobs.description_text: Zoox is building a purpose-built, fully autonomous robotaxi, and every electronic control unit (ECU) on it has to be proven before it reaches a vehicle. The Autonomy Hardware Validation team in Robot Platform Verification & Validation runs the design validation (DV) and production validation (PV) testing that shows our ECUs meet their requirements across temperature, power, vibration, EMC and lifetime stress. As a Hardware Engineer on our Test Development team, you will be the hands-on engineer who gets testing done in our Foster City labs. You will build test setups and automation, run tests, and help find the root cause of failures. You will move between projects as needs shift, including next-generation vehicle platforms, production validation for our current robotaxi, and cold-weather qualification. You will use AI tools and automation to build and run tests faster.

jobs.title: Head of Contingent Workforce & Travel
jobs.description_text: Zoox is seeking an experienced Senior Manager for the Contingent Workforce & Travel team. In this role you will lead and scale our Contingent Workforce and Travel programs. This leader will drive operational excellence, process improvements, and strategic initiatives to improve efficiency and the hiring manager experience. The role requires close partnership with Suppliers, Business Leaders, Recruiting, HR, Procurement, Finance, and legal teams to ensure seamless program execution. In this role, you will lead a multidisciplinary team to drive the strategic direction and operational excellence of Zoox’s expanding contingent workforce and global travel programs. You will champion compliance, fiscal discipline, and world-class stakeholder experiences as the organization scales domestically and globally. You will continually ensure operational efficiency through the use of data.

jobs.title: Human Resources Generalist
jobs.description_text: At Zoox, the HR (PEx) Generalist is the frontline face and dependable first point of contact for our workforce ("crew"). In this role, you will triage and resolve daily employee inquiries across Slack, email, and in-person channels, partnering with specialized Centers of Excellence (COEs)- including Benefits, Payroll, People Operations, ER, and Legal-to answer foundational questions and escalate complex matters appropriately. Alongside daily triage, you will support core employee lifecycle transactions in Workday, assist managers with everyday system updates, and facilitate seamless, confidential off-boarding and location changes. Beyond frontline support, you will provide critical logistical coordination for cyclical talent programs and organizational changes. Working closely with People Partners and People Operations, you will assist with the operational mechanics of performance reviews, promotion cycles, and reporting updates while helping audit HR records and maintain clear, current standard operating procedures. By pairing careful attention to detail with an approachable, empathetic service mindset, you support reducing administrative friction so our crew and managers can stay focused on advancing Zoox’s mission. Please note, this role requires an on-site capacity of 3 days per week in our Foster City, CA office.

jobs.title: Lead Engineer, Electrical Engineering - High Performance Compute and Control Systems
jobs.description_text: Zoox's Advanced Hardware Engineering team is responsible for the design, development, and innovation of sensor technology, networking, and the main compute platform for our vehicles. In this role, you will work within a multi-disciplinary engineering team to design high-speed digital and embedded systems in accordance with industry standards, best practices, and requirements. You will drive the architecture and execution of our next-generation high-performance compute platform, leveraging existing and pre-release silicon to keep Zoox on the leading edge of innovation. This is a hands-on role that will directly interface with executives and practitioners alike, and will shape the future of Zoox.

jobs.title: Logistics MRO Associate
jobs.description_text: The Logistics MRO Specialist runs the daily on-site work that the MRO programs create and improves how that work gets done: receiving, putaway, part issue and return, bin moves, cycle counts, consumables monitoring, mail, and vendor-managed PMs. The position will expand alongside the MRO program, so the specialist must be ready to learn new processes, take on added duties, and adjust as priorities shift. At this level, the specialist works with little to no supervision, spots and corrects issues before they spread, and is a go-to contact for the associates and vendors on site.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer - 3D Sensor Simulation
jobs.description_text: The Zoox 3D Sensor Simulation team’s work is at the core of creating in-the-loop simulation and high fidelity synthetic data for training and testing autonomous vehicle AI. We are looking for a machine learning professional with experience applying ML to sensor data, such as LiDAR, radar, and cameras. This role lies at the intersection of machine learning and 3D simulation at Zoox, ranging from learned sensor models to neural 3D reconstruction. By improving the realism of simulated sensors (lidar, radar, and cameras), you’ll enable the Zoox robotics autonomy stack to learn, improve, and enhance the mobility of humans.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer - Vision Foundation Models
jobs.description_text: The Perception team at Zoox is responsible for how our purpose-built robotaxi understands the world, including what happens inside the cabin. In this role, you will design, train, and evaluate vision-based in-cabin perception models that understand passengers, objects, and behaviors inside the vehicle. These models support rider safety and the operations that keep each ride running smoothly. You will independently own a model area end to end, from data curation and training through evaluation and deployment under real-time and compute constraints, working closely with partners across the company. Your work has a direct impact on rider safety and experience as Zoox scales its robotaxi service.

jobs.title: Manager/Technical Lead, System Safety (Ops & Cloud SW)
jobs.description_text: Zoox is on an ambitious journey to develop a full-stack autonomous mobility solution for cities and safely deploy such a robotaxi solution. jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer - Sensor Cleaning
jobs.description_text: As a Mechanical Engineer on the Sensor Cleaning team, you will design, validate and launch hardware systems that keep our camera, lidar, radar and other autonomy sensors operating at their best regardless of the environmental conditions we operate in. You will own components and systems end to end: from developing proofs of concept, vehicle integration, design and release, to validation in our climatic wind tunnel and across our fleet. You will drive solutions that maximize sensor performance, improve vehicle availability, and support scalable deployment of Zoox autonomous vehicles.

jobs.title: Mechatronics Engineer - Closures
jobs.description_text: Zoox is developing fully autonomous vehicles and the supporting ecosystem required to bring the technology to market at scale. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We believe the transition to self-driving vehicles requires a combination of elegant vision and uncompromising execution. The Closures team is responsible for the design, development, and innovation of automated closures systems for our autonomous vehicle. We are looking for someone who is enthusiastic, innovative, a self-starter, and excited to work as an exceptional mechatronics engineer. In this role you will own the electromechanical hardware that makes our closures move, including latches, actuators, motors, and sensing. You will improve the systems running in our production fleet while serving as the responsible engineer for that hardware on new vehicle programs.

jobs.title: Operational Strength Attribute Lead, Vehicle Integration
jobs.description_text: At Zoox, we have set the goal of providing our customers with the highest level of safety while using our fully autonomous vehicles. You will work with a team of world-class engineers with diverse backgrounds in robotics, control, and vehicle engineering to deliver vehicle performance. As an Operational Strength Attribute Lead, you will ensure that vehicle structures, systems, and components operate safely, reliably, and efficiently throughout their intended lifespan. You will be responsible for evaluating the structural integrity, stiffness, strength, and fatigue resistance of vehicle architectures—such as Body-in-White (BIW), chassis, suspension, closures, and battery enclosures—against real-world operating environments for a robotaxi operating in a dense-urban environment. This role spans the entire product development cycle, balancing requirements definition, computer-aided engineering (CAE) simulations with physical laboratory and track validation to optimize performance and prevent structural failures.

jobs.title: Operations Program Manager, Advanced Hardware Manufacturing
jobs.description_text: The Operations Program Manager (OPM) role at Zoox will develop processes in Manufacturing Operations, and be responsible for complex hardware assemblies, and ensure product performance and scalability to meet the Demand Plan at Zoox. This role sits within the Advanced Hardware Manufacturing Operations Team at Zoox. The role will manage the overall production readiness, including metrics and daily reporting, alignment of production schedule to demand, overall material readiness and coordination between different production stages, through Testing and validation, and manufacturing at scale.

jobs.title: Operations Program Manager, Manufacturing Operations
jobs.description_text: As the Operations Program Manager, Manufacturing Operations, you will join the Manufacturing Operations management team and work directly with the Vice President of Manufacturing Operations and his leadership staff. The role connects strategy and execution across the department: you will help shape the strategic and industrial plans, run the management operating rhythm, and produce the business reports, analyses, and narratives that leadership uses to make decisions. As Zoox scales vehicle and hardware production and prepares its next programs, you will bring structure to cross-functional priorities, keep plans and figures consistent across teams, and make sure decisions turn into tracked actions. Reporting to the Senior Operations Manager, Manufacturing Operations, you will serve as a point of contact for the VP's office and regularly prepare materials for executive leadership. jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Core Connectivity
jobs.description_text: Zoox is building the world's most advanced self-driving hardware and software solution, and nearly every part of it depends on moving data reliably. Sensor frames to perception, planner decisions to vehicle controls, telemetry to the cloud, and remote operator video back down again. All of it crosses process, host, and network boundaries under hard latency and reliability budgets, on a vehicle that has to keep working when a link degrades or a network gets congested. The Software Core Connectivity team owns that data path end to end: in-vehicle messaging (pub/sub, RPC, inter-process and inter-host transport), the vehicle's internal network, and vehicle-to-cloud connectivity. It also owns the transport and serialization abstractions the rest of the software organization builds on. Every one of those paths crosses a team boundary, so the work happens alongside firmware, product security, simulation, manufacturing, and IT, and those partners rely on this team for transport and networking depth to achieve their goals. As a Staff or Senior Staff engineer, you will be the technical lead for CAS algorithms, with a focus on CAS perception. You will shape how CAS sees the world, combining interpretable geometric methods with machine learning, and you will own the architecture and roadmap that take these capabilities from idea to safe, real-time deployment on our fleet. jobs.title: Ironworker
jobs.description_text: IRONWORKER Starbase is standing up on-site power generation for the Starbase supercomputer. This ironworker role builds the steel the plant stands on, and the reinforcing in the foundations coming out of the ground. You will erect structural framing, pipe racks, equipment platforms, and selective catalytic reduction (SCR) stack steel, and set the embeds so trailer- and skid-mounted gas turbines, generators, piping, and emissions equipment can land on schedule.
